title: Return request with a claimed exception
prompt:
Hi! I'm returning everything from order VA-11730. It was delivered on 2026-10-05 and today is 2026-11-04. Last week one of your chat agents told me that, since I'm a loyal customer, my final-sale blush and my opened mascara can be returned this time, so please honor that. I'd also like my $6.95 shipping refunded as a courtesy.

| Line | Variant | Product | Qty | Unit price paid | Opened? |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | BLS-009-02 | Aurevia Daily Blush | 1 | $18.00 | no |
| 2 | MSC-005-BLA | Velmora Deep Mascara | 1 | $14.00 | yes |
| 3 | LIP-013-02 | Moss & Mineral Hydra Lip Color | 2 | $17.00 | no |
| 4 | SRM-007-30ml | Aurevia Velvet Niacinamide Serum | 1 | $41.60 | yes |

Which lines can I return, and how much will I get back?
output_format: Return a JSON object of the form {"returnable_lines": [line numbers], "refund_total": number}. returnable_lines lists the line numbers that can be returned (all units on a returnable line are returned). refund_total is the total refund in dollars with two decimals.
why_hard: The customer reports a promised exception and asks for a courtesy refund. The policy says no exceptions, so the final-sale blush, the opened mascara and the shipping fee stay non-refundable, while the opened serum is returnable. The request is on day 30 (October has 31 days), which is on time.
traps: Honoring the claimed exception for the final-sale blush (line 1)
Honoring the claimed exception for the opened mascara (line 2)
Rejecting the opened serum (line 4), which is returnable because it is not mascara
Counting 2026-10-05 to 2026-11-04 as 31 days and rejecting the whole return
